title: Quality Studio repository registry v1
description: The server-owned registry at <API content root>/.quality-studio/repositories.json, and the shape of one registration as the /api/repos routes return it. The file is a bare array. Two invariants span entries and are enforced by the host, not by this schema: ids are unique, and every externalRefs system:id key is held by at most one entry, both compared without regard to case.

rootPath.description: Normalized absolute path. The registration's identity for everything except external lookup.

externalRefs.description: Optional, added for the Agent Studio integration (QSI-3). Absent on registrations that carry none, including every registration written before the field existed.

system.description: The naming system, a lowercase slug. Agent Studio uses agent-studio.

id.description: The id in that system, for example the Agent Studio project id PROJ-002. Case is kept; lookups ignore it.

url.description: Where a person finds the referenced item. Display only; never used for lookup or authorization.
